Logo

One component over the three logo families: 24 square product marks (colour + mono), 5 wordmark lockups, and 13 illustrative product elements. Unlike the rest of the library it references real artwork — a logo has no token that can stand in for it.

42 assetsmark · wordmark · elementFigma 471:112

Preview

Product marks — colour & mono

Twelve products, each with a colour and a black-knockout mono variant. mono is a boolean, not a separate file you pick by hand.
IronPDFproduct="pdf"
IronWordproduct="wd"
IronXLproduct="xl"
IronPPTproduct="ppt"

Iron Suiteproduct="suite"
Iron Softwareproduct="iron"

Sizes

The mark is drawn on an 8-unit grid at 192px. Each halving halves the grid unit, so only 24 · 48 · 96 · 192 keep every edge on a whole pixel — the size prop is typed to those four.

Wordmarks

Two brands, three variants. ondark keeps the colour mark and turns “IRON” white; mono is a single-colour knockout for brand-colour or photographic backgrounds. Iron Suite has no mono artwork in Figma — asking for it falls back to default rather than 404.

Product elements

Illustrative marks for feature cards, empty states and docs headers — used alongside the product logo, never instead of it. A separate family with its own names (word, not wd).

Product lockups

Figma’s Product logo set — the mark and wordmark locked together. basic is the horizontal lockup, stack the vertical one. Sized by height, like a wordmark, since neither layout is square.

Anatomy

artwork → {basePath}/mark-{product}.svg box → size × size alt → PRODUCT_NAMES[product] link shape → --rounded-sm focus ring → --color-border-selected

Props

PropTypeDefaultNotes
kind'mark' | 'wordmark' | 'element' | 'lockup''mark'Picks the family. lockup is the mark and wordmark locked together.
productProduct | ElementName'iron'Marks use wd/bc/prt/ws; elements use word/barcode/print/webscraper.
brand'iron' | 'suite''iron'Wordmark only.
variant'default' | 'ondark' | 'mono' | 'onhero' | 'basic' | 'stack''default'Scoped to the kind: wordmark takes the first four, lockup takes basic/stack. mono and onhero are iron-only; suite falls back to default and ondark.
monobooleanfalseMark only — the black knockout artwork.
size16 | 24 | 32 | 48 | 64 | 72 | 96 | 144 | 19248Mark / element. The standard icon ladder. What each rung costs in crispness is measured by check:logo-grid and reported, not enforced — one drawing cannot stay sharp across a whole ladder, and the fix for that is artwork, not a shorter type.
heightnumber32Wordmark / lockup — width follows the aspect ratio. Free, because neither is square or on the mark's grid.
hrefstring—Renders an <a> with aria-label instead of a <span>.
labelstring—Overrides alt text. Pass "" when a visible name sits next to it.
basePathstring'assets'Where docs/assets/ was copied to.

Code

          
<!-- marks — 12 products × colour/mono -->
<Logo product="pdf" />
<Logo product="pdf" mono />
<Logo product="suite" size={96} />

<!-- wordmarks — iron: default/ondark/mono · suite: default/ondark -->
<Logo kind="wordmark" brand="iron" />
<Logo kind="wordmark" brand="iron" variant="ondark" height={40} />

<!-- illustrative product elements -->
<Logo kind="element" product="drawing" />

<!-- as a link, and decorative next to a visible name -->
<Logo product="pdf" href="/ironpdf" />
<Logo product="pdf" label="" /> <span>IronPDF</span>

Guidelines

✓ Do
  • Use one of the ladder sizes — 24 · 48 · 72 · 96 · 144 · 192. They are the multiples of 24, which is where the industry's 8-point icon grid and this artwork's 96-unit box agree; every other size renders more anti-aliased edges.
  • Use mono/variant="mono" instead of a CSS filter.
  • Pass label="" when a visible product name sits beside the mark.
  • Point basePath at your own asset folder rather than deep-linking the docs.
✗ Don't
  • Don't set a non-square box — the mark distorts.
  • Don't recolour with filter; there is a real mono asset.
  • Don't go below 24px — the counters inside the letterforms fill in.
  • Don't mix families: an element is not a substitute for a mark.
